result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of an introduction to a treatise on functions representable by the Gaussian series F(α, β, γ, x), describing the hypergeometric series as one whose ratio of the (n+1)th to the nth term is a rational function of n, and introducing the terminology of hypergeometric series of higher order.
